blocks.text: LONDON — Russell Brand, the risqué comic who bragged for years of his sexual exploits, was convicted Thursday, Nov. 5, of raping one woman and sexually assaulting three others on allegations dating back years. The British actor-comedian faces a “significant” prison term when he is sentenced Monday, Judge Joel Bennathan said.
